summary: Tested IMEI registration in the product form (create, edit, inline from sale) and the IMEI auto-fill in /sale/new. Backend: 6 new tests plus the full regression suite, 34/34 passing. Frontend: found and fixed one blocking bug. A typed IMEI that was never added with Enter was not counted in the purchase quantity, so the purchase total showed EUR 0 and paid defaulted to 0. With no supplier selected, saving failed with 'Zgjidh furnitorin që të regjistrohet borxhi'; with a supplier selected, a false debt would be recorded. After the fix, every requested flow passes end to end.

minor.issue: Uniqueness check matches IMEIs of any status, sold ones included. A phone sold and later bought back (for example from a citizen) cannot be registered under a new product, because its IMEI is still 'sold' on the old product. Consider checking only status in_stock (or not sold).
The purchase validation uses qty = len(imeis) or quantity, but the stored quantity is max(quantity, len(imeis)). The two differ when quantity > number of IMEIs. Not blocking.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: an IMEI typed but not added with Enter was not counted in qty, so the purchase total was EUR 0, paid was 0 and the backend rejected the save ('Zgjidh furnitorin...'). qty now includes pending IMEIs.

issues: addImei does not remove duplicates inside a single pasted string ('111 111' gives 2 badges). The backend removes them on save, so this is cosmetic only.
